text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging: high tail latency observed in production after recent deploy (deploy-id=deploy-2026-02-15-rc3). Alert group: runtime/p95>1.8s across us-east-1. Please ack and triage.

sara-oncall: acked. I'm on it. Any initial signal about which routes/models affected?

mike-runtime: seeing p95 jump from ~220ms -> ~1.9s on text-generation route /v1/generate. Throughput down ~30% on affected slices. Kernel fallback logs show increased fallback-to-cpu for small-slice workers.

jon-eng-sre: noted. I see a spike in kernel-selector logs around 04:12 UTC: "kernel_mismatch -> fallback_path cpu" repeated. Likely a selector policy change in the rollout. Linking logs: https://logs.redwood/trace/abc123

lina-support: customer reports — AcmeCorp seeing slow responses and some ops timeouts in their UI. They've opened a ticket. Kev, can you confirm impact & SLA risk?

kevin-customer-ops: AcmeCorp: 18% of requests exceeding 2s over last 10m, some timed requests from dashboard. Reached out to their SRE already, keeping them updated. No P1 yet but heading that way if not mitigated in 15m.

sara-oncall: initial mitigation plan: 1) hold rollout (kill switch ff: ff/enable-small-slice -> off) 2) revert canary to previous deploy 3) increase kernel affinity to prefer gpu-optimized kernels. Who can flip the feature flag now?

mike-runtime: I can flip the flag. Flipping to off now.

mike-runtime: DONE -> executed:
```
curl -X POST https://flags.redwood/api/ff/enable-small-slice/off -H "Authorization: Bearer ****"
```

sara-oncall: thanks. watching metrics.

jon-eng-sre: starting rollback of canary group to deploy-2026-02-14-prod. Rolling back slice-group a,b now. /deploy rollback --id=deploy-2026-02-15-rc3 --scope=canary

jon-eng-sre: rollback job started. Will update when rollbacks finish.

incident-bot: Rollback job [job-9876] completed: 12 hosts replaced. Post-rollback checks running.

mike-runtime: kernel selector metrics improving; fallback_count down 70% after flag off and rollback starting. p95 trending down to ~420ms.

sara-oncall: good. keep an eye on throughput and GPU utilization for flashbacks. Also validate KV cache hit rates didn't regress with rollback.

kevin-customer-ops: telling AcmeCorp rollback in progress and ETA ~10m. They appreciate the quick response :thumbsup:

lina-support: note for postmortem: include why kernel selector flip happened in rollout and clarify guardrails for feature flags and canary sizing.

sara-oncall: handing off to oncall shift B for full post-deploy followup and RCA. @mike-runtime @jon-eng-sre please add notes to incident channel. I'm dropping from thread, monitor until resolved. :wave:

jon-eng-sre: will collect logs, kernel-selector diffs, and canary config. Adding runbook steps and timeline.

mike-runtime: will open postmortem draft, include metrics, flags, commands we ran, and customer impact summary. Tentative severity: Sev2. Assigning to myself and @sara-oncall for review.

incident-bot: Incident state: mitigated -> reduced customer impact, ongoing monitoring. If regression returns reopen paging.
